title: EvidenceRecords
description: Declared records the atlas reducer consumes ALONGSIDE the fcd journal. These are NOT fcd journal events and never enter e.events: the fcd machine owns the journal. Plan/question/artifact records let the cockpit show intent (planned lines), unresolved questions, and real runnable artifacts without pretending they are observed machine transitions. A planned item carries no executed model; a question blocks only its node; an artifact's present/runnable are observed facts.

planItem.description: A declared, not-yet-opened line. Becomes an item node with status 'planned'. If an fcd 'open' event later appears for the same id, the observed status supersedes 'planned'.

questionRecord.description: An unresolved question attached to an EXACT node. The reducer rejects a record whose node_id is not a known node. resolved=false sets that node's blocked=true and NOTHING else.

artifactRecord.description: A real, addressable artifact attached to a node. present/runnable are observed facts, not aspirations.
